_comment: Each check of the platform host's interface check, with the NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls whose statements it supports and the FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicators. Every control-to-KSI pair reuses one another kit's requirements file already uses (for example CM-7 to KSI-CNA-RNT, SC-7 to KSI-CNA-MAT, SC-8 and SC-12 to KSI-SVC-SIN and KSI-SVC-ASM, AU-2 and AU-12 to KSI-MLA-LET, CM-6 to KSI-SVC-ACM, AC-3 and AC-6 to KSI-IAM-ELP, IA-5 to KSI-IAM-SNU, CM-2 and SI-7 to KSI-SVC-ACM and KSI-SVC-VRI, CA-7 to KSI-MLA-EVC, SI-4 to KSI-MLA-LET, CP-10 to KSI-RPL-ABO, CM-8 to KSI-PIY-GIV, AU-9 to KSI-MLA-OSM); CP-9 is listed with the backup check without a KSI of its own. Book 10, Appendix B's control crosswalk names the controls per interface. Which check supports which control is the program's reading (design guidance); the agency's assessor decides. KSIs are FedRAMP's indicators for cloud service providers: the agency lines its own evidence up with what its providers report against them and doesn't report KSIs itself.

PH-01.title: Listeners: Gitea on loopback HTTP and its SSH port only, IIS on 443, nothing on 80

PH-02.title: Firewall: every profile on, inbound blocked by default, allow rules for the published ports

PH-03.title: TLS: the 443 certificate's key, expiry and name; TLS 1.0 and 1.1 off

PH-04.title: Reverse proxy: one catch-all rule to loopback, ARR without host rewrite, request size, HSTS, WebSockets

PH-05.title: IIS log: W3C on a local drive, hourly, with the fields the evidence needs

PH-06.title: Gitea app.ini: the expected settings, secrets present but never read

PH-07.title: Service identity: the gitea service's account, start mode and RUN_USER

PH-08.title: Storage: no broad principal can write to the data, repository or backup folders

PH-09.title: Release manifest: gitea.exe and the running version are the pinned release

PH-10.title: Gitea API: sign-in required, webhooks only to listed receivers, mirrors fresh, few administrators

PH-11.title: Backup: the newest dump is inside the recovery point

PH-12.title: Azure Arc: the Connected Machine agent is connected

EVIDENCE.title: Record the run: snapshots and results hashed and chained
